parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The ID of the organization. You can get this ID from the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline. You can get this ID from the pipeline URL, for example, `https://flow.aliyun.com/pipelines/{pipelineId}/current`.

parameters.name: pipelineRunId
parameters.description: The ID of the pipeline run.
